prompt.limit.short_reasoning: no more than roughly 50 English words
prompt.limit.movement_reasoning: ideally no more than 200 English words and never more than 250 English words
prompt.epilogue_content_count: Write about {count} actual scene entries in the VN epilogue. Count only dialogue or narration entries; blank separator lines and wrapper tags do not count.
log.table_started: # Three Estates table log started at {timestamp}
terminal.choose_conversation_mode: Choose conversational mode for this run: 'casual' prioritizes ordinary character conversation until three quarters of the earliest-expiring table timer has elapsed; 'ultra casual' keeps that casual posture and casual phase timing throughout the entire game; 'strategic' keeps conversation centered on the social-deduction game.
terminal.choose_manual_seating: Do you want to manually assign the starting seats? yes or no
terminal.choose_character_table: Starting table for {name} ({tables}); enter its number or name:
terminal.choose_context_mode:
Choose context handling for this new game:
- 'keep': keep the saved ongoing scenario context, clothing, full relationship records, and game-only relationship additions as they currently are.
- 'fresh': start from permanent initial context and base relationships, then enter replacement game-only scenario context, choose clothing handling, and enter fresh shared, A-to-B, and B-to-A game-only relationship context.
- 'base': use only permanent initial context and base relationships, omit clothing, and use no temporary additions.
Previous-game summaries remain archived but are excluded from all three modes.
terminal.session_found:
Existing session data found in {path} ({note}). Choose one:
{continue_option}- 'new' to archive everything and generate a fully new cast
- 'same roles' to reuse these characters, roles, and established relationships, but wipe game state/memory/logs
- 'reroll roles' to reuse these characters and established relationships with reassigned roles, wiping game state/memory/logs
- 'exact setup' to reuse these characters, roles, established relationships, starting tables, and starting movement cooldowns while wiping game state/memory/logs
terminal.continue_setup: - 'continue' to resume the interrupted new-cast setup
terminal.invalid_session_mode: Please type 'continue', 'new', 'same roles', 'reroll roles', or 'exact setup'.
terminal.choose_game_mode: Choose game size/ruleset: type '10' for base mode or '16' for expanded mode:
terminal.choose_generation_mode: Choose character generation role assignment: type 'normal' to generate one character per shuffled role, or 'immersion' to generate the cast first and assign roles by temperament:
terminal.choose_reroll_mode: Choose reroll role assignment: type 'normal' to reassign roles randomly, or 'immersion' to reassign them by character temperament and dramatic/strategic fit:
terminal.choose_appearance: Should innate physical appearance be a factor for this cast? yes or no
terminal.choose_clothing: Choose clothing handling: 'none' to omit clothing as a factor, 'automatic' to generate it, or 'custom' to enter it yourself:
terminal.context_override:
DEBUG POST-GENERATION CONTEXT OVERRIDE:
Enter replacement character/group context to use for appearance generation, relationship generation, the actual game, and future reused games. The already generated characters and personalities will not be regenerated. Press Enter to keep the original character-generation context:
terminal.previous_context: Do you want this new game to carry over the context established by previous games? yes or no
terminal.enter_generation_context: Enter the context in which you generate characters:
terminal.enter_replacement_context: Enter fresh replacement character/scenario context for THIS NEW GAME ONLY. The previous game's temporary context is ignored. Press Enter for no scenario addition and to proceed directly to the per-relationship game-only context ritual:
terminal.no_replacement_context: No game-only scenario context entered; using only the permanent initial context.
terminal.relationship_exists: Do {first} and {second} know each other before this game? yes or no
terminal.any_relationships: Do you want at least some of them to know each other beforehand? yes or no
terminal.relationship_game_shared: 2/4 — Enter additional relationship context shared by {first} and {second} for THIS GAME ONLY, or press Enter for none:
terminal.relationship_game_first: 3/4 — Enter additional relationship context applying only to {first}'s view of {second} for THIS GAME ONLY, or press Enter for none:
terminal.relationship_game_second: 4/4 — Enter additional relationship context applying only to {second}'s view of {first} for THIS GAME ONLY, or press Enter for none:
terminal.fresh_relationship_shared: 1/3 — Enter relationship context shared by {first} and {second} for THIS NEW GAME ONLY, or press Enter for none:
terminal.fresh_relationship_first: 2/3 — Enter context applying only to {first}'s view of {second} for THIS NEW GAME ONLY, or press Enter for none:
terminal.fresh_relationship_second: 3/3 — Enter context applying only to {second}'s view of {first} for THIS NEW GAME ONLY, or press Enter for none:
terminal.update_relationship_shared: Enter replacement relationship context for both directional records, or press Enter for no shared replacement. A non-empty answer replaces each record's entire old marked tail, not only its first paragraph:
terminal.update_relationship_first: Enter direction-specific context for the NEW marked tail only in {first}'s relationship record about {second}, or press Enter for none:
terminal.update_relationship_second: Enter direction-specific context for the NEW marked tail only in {second}'s relationship record about {first}, or press Enter for none:
terminal.generated_start_or_quit: Characters and their starting relationships are generated. Type 'start' to begin this game now, or 'quit' to save the prepared cast and stop here:
terminal.prepared_cast_saved: Prepared character set and relationships saved. Exiting before seating/game start.
terminal.no_base_relationships: No permanent base relationships exist between this cast, so there is no game-specific relationship context to enter.
terminal.fresh_relationship_intro: Fresh game-only relationship context follows for every established pair. These additions replace the previous game's temporary relationship context, remain separate from the permanent base records, and do not carry into another new game.
terminal.no_relationship_updates: No established relationships exist between the characters in this cast, so there are no relationship updates to enter.
terminal.relationship_update_intro: Optional between-game relationship updates follow. For each affected directional record, everything from the first BETWEEN-GAME RELATIONSHIP UPDATE marker through the end—including all later sentences, paragraphs, and direction-specific details—is replaced. Both complete old directional records are retained in character_context.json metadata.
postgame.fallback_summary: The game ended with {winners} winning, while {losers} lost. The night's conversations and choices left the cast to reckon with the alliances, suspicions, and surprises that developed between them.
postgame.fallback_epilogue: *The room settles after the final bell, everyone too tired and too awake to leave just yet.*
terminal.keyboard_interrupt: Keyboard interrupt received. Stopping without saving a mid-timestep state.
terminal.resume_checkpoint: Resume will use the latest stable checkpoint: {path}
terminal.no_checkpoint: No stable checkpoint exists yet, so there is no game state to resume from.
terminal.stop_after_llm: Stopping simulation immediately without saving a mid-timestep state.
event.bishop.attempt: {bishop} reveals their {role} card and attempts to use their {role} ability on {target} by guessing {family}.
event.bishop.correct_guess: The Bishop {bishop} correctly guesses {target}'s family as {family}, so {target} must leave for {destination}.
event.bishop.wrong_guess_hard_reveal: {target} reveals their {role} card to prove that the Bishop {bishop}'s guess of {family} was wrong.
event.lock.nullified_by_theft: {holder}'s {role} lockdown on {targets} is nullified because {baron} stole the {role} card.
event.movement.blocked_by_timer: {target} cannot leave or be forced out by {benefactor}'s {role} ability because the {table} timer lockdown is final.
event.timer.expired: The {table} timer expires; {table} is now under final timer lockdown. Nobody seated there can leave by normal movement or be moved out by any voluntary or forced role ability, though players may still enter.
event.table.no_action: The table falls quiet; no action bid is strong enough for anyone to act.
event.card.reveal_failed: {character} tries to reveal their {role} card, but cannot prove it because they do not have that role card.
event.card.reveal_global: {character} reveals their {role} card to all tables without using the ability.
event.card.reveal_without_ability: {character} reveals their {role} card without using the ability.
event.card.global_reveal_heard: From the {table}, {description}; the reveal was made loudly and visibly enough for every table to verify, but only Barons physically at the origin table can react to it.
event.ability.attempt: {character} reveals their {role} card and attempts to use the {role} ability on {target}.
event.ability.missing_card: {character} reaches for their {role} card, but cannot use the ability because they do not have it.
event.queen.blocked_by_farmer: {target} reveals their Farmer card and is immune to {queen}'s Queen drag; {target} remains at {table}.
event.queen.blocked_by_king: {queen}'s Queen drag attempt on {target} fails because {target}'s family, {family}, is held by a King's lockdown at {table}.
event.queen.exile_attempt: {queen} reveals their Queen card and attempts to use the Queen ability on {target} while being exiled by Bishop {bishop}.
event.queen.exile_drag: {queen} reveals their Queen card while being exiled and drags {target} to {destination} using the Queen ability.
event.queen.drag_departure: {queen} reveals their Queen card and leaves for {destination} while dragging {target} using the Queen ability.
event.queen.drag_failed_departure: {queen} leaves for {destination} after the Queen drag attempt on {target} fails against the King's lockdown.
event.spinster.exile_attempt: {spinster} reveals their Spinster card and attempts to mark {target} while being exiled by Bishop {bishop} to {destination}.
event.spinster.mark_departure: {spinster} reveals their Spinster card, attempts to mark {target}, and leaves {origin} for {destination}.
event.spinster.mark_departure_resolved: {spinster} leaves for {destination} after marking {target} with the Spinster ability.
event.spinster.reveal_blocked_nun: {target} is forced by the departing Spinster {spinster} to reveal a role card, but shows the Nun protection card instead, so the forced reveal fails.
event.spinster.reveal_missing_card: {target} is forced by the departing Spinster {spinster} to reveal a role card, but cannot produce their own role card, so the forced reveal fails.
event.spinster.forced_reveal: {target} is forced by the departing Spinster {spinster} to reveal their {role} card.
event.innkeeper.attempt: {innkeeper} reveals their Innkeeper card and attempts to declare as Innkeeper to lock down everyone at the {village}.
event.innkeeper.lock: {innkeeper} reveals their Innkeeper card, declares as Innkeeper, and locks down everyone at the {village}.
event.king.lock: {king} reveals their King card and locks down all currently present members of {family} at {table}.
event.nun.protection: {target} reveals the Nun card protecting them and is protected from {source}'s {role} effect.
event.nun.give_protection: {nun} reveals their Nun card and gives it to protect {target}.
event.nun.show_failed: {character} tries to show the Nun card protecting them, but cannot produce it.
event.nun.show_protection: {character} reveals the Nun card protecting them without revealing their actual role card.
event.priest.force_reveal: The Priest {priest} forces {target} to reveal their {role} card.
event.thief.blocked_by_thief: {thief}'s Thief swap attempt on {target} fails because Thieves are immune to Thief swaps.
event.thief.swap: {thief} reveals their {old_role} card and forcefully swaps roles and cards with {target}. {target} is now the Thief, while {thief} is now {thief_new_role}.
event.baron.attempt_trophies: {baron} reveals their Baron card and attempts to steal {target}'s Baron trophies without taking the Baron role card.
event.baron.attempt_block_steal: {baron} reveals their Baron card and attempts to block {target}'s {role} ability and steal the {role} card.
event.baron.attempt_steal: {baron} reveals their Baron card and attempts to steal {target}'s {role} card after the reveal.
event.baron.countersteal_trophies: {baron} reveals their Baron card, countersteals {target}'s Baron trophies (known visible trophies: {known}), and does not take the Baron role card.
event.baron.block_trophies: {baron} reveals their Baron card, blocks {target}'s Baron ability, and steals {target}'s Baron trophies without taking the Baron role card.
event.baron.steal_trophies: {baron} reveals their Baron card after {target}'s reveal and steals {target}'s Baron trophies without taking the Baron role card.
event.baron.block_steal: {baron} reveals their Baron card, blocks {target}'s {role} ability, and steals the {role} card.
event.baron.steal_after_reveal: {baron} reveals their Baron card after {target}'s reveal and steals the {role} card.
event.card.retrieval_unavailable: {character} considers retrieving a card, but no valid retrieval condition is currently met.
event.card.request_nun_return: The Nun {nun} asks {holder} to return the Nun card and end the protection.
event.card.request_stolen_return: {character} asks {holder} whether they can return the {role} card after a Baron theft.
event.card.failure.holder_left: {holder} is no longer at the table.
event.card.failure.no_nun: {holder} no longer has the Nun card.
event.card.retrieve_nun_still_protected: The Nun {nun} retrieves their Nun card from {holder}, but {holder} remains protected by another Nun card.
event.card.retrieve_nun_revoke: The Nun {nun} retrieves their Nun card from {holder} and revokes protection from {holder}.
